source_work: Noah Webster, An American Dictionary of the English Language (1828)
rights_basis: The original 1828 dictionary text is public domain.
selection_method: Continued the three-occurrence KJV tier with the next four exact-headword source-verifiable candidates after the phase 13 batch.
review_method: Imported the complete displayed definition without editorial rewriting, independently verified each exact-headword page, normalized whitespace only, and required an exact match to the stored overlay.
guardrails: No base OCR entry was rewritten.
No related-word or missing-result page was accepted.
No definition wording was summarized, modernized, or invented.
Source paragraph counts are retained as source line ranges in the overlay records.
